name: Orbit
summary: Four code boxes that whirl into the middle and become a single check mark
about: A clean 4-digit one-time code field with a neon violet look. When the code is right the four boxes spin into the centre, shrink away and leave one drawn check mark. Good for sign-in checks, two-step verification and phone or email confirmation.
how: Type, paste or autofill the demo code; backspace and the arrow keys move between boxes
When the fourth digit lands, a light runs across the boxes while the code is checked
A right code makes the boxes spin into the middle and turn into a check mark
A wrong code wobbles the boxes in red and clears them so you can try again
